title: A check that is neither a test nor a build never acknowledges: Markdown-only items can't be evaluated on a link check
outcome: An item whose only required check is a documentation link check has a supported way to reach acknowledged verification, or the refusal says exactly what to do, so Markdown changes aren't stuck when evaluation is on.
acceptance: A registered documentation check on a named root reaches an acknowledged verification record through a supported route, shown by a behaviour test or a real run, or the refusal names the route; the refusal never tells a holder to wait for something that can't arrive.
No check is reported as a test or build it isn't, and existing classification stays honest. A review pair has no Medium or higher and the normal gate passes, if code changes.

completion.summary: Unsupported documentation checks now receive a specific refusal with an actionable supported route, without dishonest Test/Build classification. Landed in combo28 with fresh composite pair and eligible same-tree FULL.
